instructions_to_main_agent: Build this standalone LARP Virtual Mirror & AI Fitting Room feature in React JS with complete responsiveness.
Support both live webcam capture (via navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) and clean file upload (drag & drop or click).

Include simulated realistic AI try-on generation: when user hits 'Generate Preview' or AI chat updates the look, show an authentic 10-15s multi-stage progress (e.g., 'Analyzing facial geometry...', 'Aligning plate cuirass...', 'Synthesizing lighting and shadows...', 'Finalizing battle-ready avatar').

Equip the AI assistant with natural language understanding for queries like 'Find black helmets under $50', 'Make me look like a stealthy assassin', 'Add a shield and boots', 'Dark aesthetic'. The assistant responds with conversational advice AND directly filters the catalog or updates the equipped gear tray.
Add speech synthesis and SpeechRecognition (mic toggle) for hands-free voice styling if supported by browser, falling back smoothly.

Build a rich catalog of ~30 items with categories (Helmets, Body Armor, Cloaks & Robes, Tunics, Boots, Weapons & Shields, Accessories), price filters (< $50, $50-$100, $100+), gender cuts (Unisex, Men, Women), and aesthetic tags.
Implement an Item Detail Drawer / Modal that showcases artisan vendor, lore, specifications, price, and instant 'Equip to Mirror' / 'Unequip' buttons.
Ensure the feature is embeddable or standalone, displaying an 'Integration Helper' ribbon so hackathon judges can see how to plug it into any LARP marketplace nav/modal.
Use data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, filter toggles, catalog items, and preview canvases.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Avoid flat digital grey. Tint backgrounds with midnight slate (#0b0c10) and warm ember gold accents (#c59a53).
Never use Inter for headings. Use serif font Cinzel or Cormorant Garamond for headings and Outfit/IBM Plex for UI.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for navbars, modals, or dropdowns. Always provide solid or frosted glass backdrop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#13161c]/95).
Ensure WCAG AA contrast ratio (> 4.5:1) for all body text against dark backgrounds.
All interactive elements must have explicit hover states with text color specified and subtle scale or border glow.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback when items are equipped, selfie is captured, or AI updates the fitting room.
